issues.title: Navy seam filler reads as a raised rail lying on the pan joint (close-up artefact)
issues.evidence: e1 / e7 (z_fill_e1.png): at each inner joint a ~3 cm wide navy rounded bar runs the full pan depth from under the arm to the front edge, standing above the cushion crowns with a rounded, lit end cap at the pan front corner; it reads as an added bolster, not a shadowed slot. y_47300 / ref/web/econ show only a narrow dark crease between the cushions. At q15 it is acceptable (it shows as a dark band below the arm), but in seat view and the studio it is the most visible new object.
issues.fix: 09a_econ.js: sink the filler top 1.5-2 cm below the cushion crown (it should only be seen down inside the slot), narrow it to the slot width, stop it ~2 cm short of the pan front face and drop the end cap; use the darker seat-shadow navy (no specular) so it reads as a gap, not a part.
